persona_summary: Nora (33) lives in Antwerpen and became mum to Amir six weeks ago. She is now on maternity leave.
diary_opener: Hey Nora, I've already lived your next month. The big one: during the leave about €1,080 less came in every month, but with a plan Amir and I got through it calmly.

cards.title: This month €1,080 less came in than my usual salary
cards.body: My maternity benefit from Helan was a lot lower than my salary. My savings bridged the gap, but a plan for the leave months helped.

signals.label: Salary became benefit
signals.detail: Helan paid €1,870 on 24 September, your salary at Stad Antwerpen was €2,950

signals.label: More baby costs
signals.detail: About €190 a month on nappies and care products at Kruidvat, Aldi and Colruyt, that's new

signals.label: Question to Kate
signals.detail: You asked Kate: "When does the Groeipakket pay, and how much?"

actions.title: Your budget for the leave months
actions.body: Until your leave ends, you spend about €330 a month more than comes in. Your savings easily cover that. See it month by month.

actions.title: How your Groeipakket works
actions.body: Kidslife pays about €184 around the 10th of every month, plus a one-off birth grant of €1,311. You'll see it as soon as it comes in.

cards.title: The month after, Amir started daycare, for about €520 a month
cards.body: In early November Amir started at ’t Kuikentje. The price depended on my income, but I had already put it in my budget.

signals.label: Daycare deposit
signals.detail: You paid ’t Kuikentje a €400 deposit. Most daycares start about 5 weeks later

signals.label: Amir was born
signals.detail: Amir was born 6 weeks ago and your Groeipakket file at Kidslife is open. Congratulations!

actions.title: Daycare is already in your plan
actions.body: From November about €520 a month is in your budget. Tip: daycare costs get you a tax reduction later.

cards.title: Six weeks in, Amir still wasn't covered by my hospital insurance
cards.body: If you add a baby within 3 months, there's no waiting period. After that, Amir had to wait months for cover.

signals.label: Only you are covered
signals.detail: Your KBC Hospital Insurance covers you, not Amir. Babies added within 3 months of birth have no waiting period

signals.label: Amir was born
signals.detail: Amir was born 6 weeks ago and your Groeipakket file at Kidslife is open. Congratulations!

signals.label: Hospital bill paid
signals.detail: You paid ZNA Middelheim €860 for the birth on 17 September

actions.title: Add Amir to your hospital insurance
actions.body: Amir gets the same cover as you, with no waiting period if you add him before mid-November. About €6 a month.

cards.title: Two months in, I started a little savings pot for Amir
cards.body: Many parents start saving for their child in the first year. No rush: after your leave is fine too.

signals.label: Looked at saving for your child
signals.detail: This month you opened the "Saving for your child" page twice

signals.label: Amir was born
signals.detail: Amir was born 6 weeks ago and your Groeipakket file at Kidslife is open. Congratulations!

actions.title: A savings plan for Amir
actions.body: Start with €25 a month in a savings account or investment plan in his name. The grandparents can chip in too.
